data_returns.message: The combined DNO embedded-generation return to ESO, its stated limits, and the published loss estimates listed by source, each in its source's own words.
Not held in this evidence pack: no published feeder- or relay-level LFDD log was obtained; only the per-area returns tabulated by ESO and the E3C are available.
Per-area LFDD returns (MW, customers, final restoration time) as tabulated by ESO and the E3C, with DNO-reported relay observations; fields the published tables leave blank stay blank.

Not held in this evidence pack: no real-time output telemetry for distributed generators was obtained. Ofgem states that most DNOs only record generation volumes half-hourly and that DNOs do not monitor distributed generator output in real time.

Not held in this evidence pack: Physical Notification data for 9 August 2019 after settlement period 4 are missing from the publisher's current dataset (its ingestion status resumes on 11 August 2019).
Reconstructed control-room log from ESO's published timelines and communication tables, including ESO's earlier (28 August 2019) account.
Published loss accounting, frequency simulation, response and inertia assumptions, and differences between ESO's earlier and final accounts.
Transcription of ESO's published diagram of operational calls between its control room, NGET, DNO and Scottish control rooms.
Not held in this evidence pack: no phasor measurement (PMU/WAMS) recording of the event was obtained; the recordings are not published.
Not held in this evidence pack: stroke-level lightning records (time, location, peak current) are commercial data and were not obtained; only the figures reported by ESO and NGET are available.

Not held in this evidence pack: no turbine-controller or internal control-system log was found in the published sources; the operator's published report is the available account.
